findings.title: Fix the source repository path before creating the fixture
findings.body: With the controller in the supplied review-repo directory, `P.parents[2]` already resolves to `.../efficiency-20261015/finish-20261017`. Appending `finish-20261017/ci-green/repo` therefore duplicates that directory component. The first `git ls-tree` targets the wrong repository path and fails after `F.mkdir()` has created the one-shot fixture, so a corrected retry also fails the fixture-existence guard. Resolve the intended sibling `ci-green/repo` directly from the correct ancestor before creating the fixture.

overall_explanation: The source repository path is incorrectly constructed for the supplied controller location, preventing the bounded inspection from running and leaving a fixture directory that blocks retries. Shell inspection was unavailable because the sandbox failed to initialize; this finding follows directly from the supplied path and controller source.
